title: SNEKbot: A Telegram Trading Bot to Onboard 900M Monthly Active Users to Cardano

ms.promise:
・Separate telegram bot designed to monitor and share information on newly created tokens,
・LP for tokens and token burns done through Snekx
ms.criteria:
・Whenever a new Token gets minted through Snekx | Cardano Token Minter, a notification should be send to a telegram channel with information about the actions and tokens
・Whenever an LP gets burn through Snekx | Cardano Token Minter, a notification should be send to a telegram channel with information about the action and tokens
・Whenever an LP gets created through Snekx | Cardano Token Minter, a notification should be send to a telegram channel with information about the action and tokens

・SNEKbot external website: https://snekbot.io/
・SNEKbot TG bot: https://t.me/snekbot_bot?start=snekbot.io
・SNEKbot Alerts bot: https://t.me/snekbotalerts
